name: SSH
description: Lists the hosts in your ssh config and opens an ssh session in a new terminal, through bastion hosts when you name them. Inside a session, commands show as blocks through a shell integration that lives only for that session. A session an agent asks for opens only after you approve the exact command.

commands.title: SSH: Connect to Host…
commands.argument: Host, as you would type it after ssh: [-J bastion] [-p port] [user@]host

commands.title: User, host name, port and bastion hops of one host (JSON)

shellIntegration.title: Shell integration in ssh sessions
shellIntegration.description: Command blocks and the current folder inside bash and zsh sessions: ssh runs with -t and a fixed command that writes a private temporary folder on the host, sources it as the shell starts and deletes it at once. Nothing is installed. Turn it off for hosts that refuse a remote command
